description: An abstract class providing a common base for JSON parsing handlers within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It extends a generic JsonHandler and defines an abstract method getValue() for subclasses to implement.

classes.name: DittoJsonHandler
classes.description: An abstract generic class extending JsonHandler, serving as a base for JSON parsing handlers with specific type parameters for arrays, objects, and values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Abstract method to return the value represented by the handler or null.
